summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce routine dividend actions on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA). The board maintained the annual dividend rate at 13.00% and declared daily cash dividends of $0.0516 per share for each business day in September 2026, totaling $1.0836 per share for the month. Dividends are payable to record holders on each preceding business day. The filing also provides U.S. federal tax guidance indicating distributions may be treated as return of capital. No special-situation event (M&A, tender, restructuring, etc.) is present; this is a routine dividend declaration.
